missionPremise: P3 is a BUILD and builds do not wait for TOTALS. Absence that is SERVED, not merely stored, is the ADR-029 gap. Three states are not interchangeable: not-applicable is unincorporated only (counties do not zone); unmeasured is in-city with no landed table; absent-verified is after a probe found none. Operator ruling 2026-08-31_bastrop_setbacks_bake_ruling item 2 is not reopenable: an in-city parcel with no landed setback table serves unmeasured, NEVER not-applicable. L7 satisfied-absent is county SCORE vocabulary and is not copied onto parcel rails. Sources: _dispatches/2026-08-31_a4-p3-build_dispatch.md; _decisions/2026-08-31_bastrop_setbacks_bake_ruling.md; 80_adrs/adr_029_building_footprint_and_utility_easement_rails.md; _inbox/2026-08-12_L7_sparse_rail_absence_doctrine.md; _inbox/2026-08-05_T3_easement_source_recon.md; _inbox/2026-08-30_ctx_w3_rail_inventory_WDLL.md.
completionPredicate: Uncommitted Factory diff plus this card's CP1/CP2/close. Schema for collect_close and rail_absence exists and seeds no absence rows. Writer refuses an unprobed absence, a request-clock asOf, a basis identical across two parcels, and not-applicable on an in-city parcel. Serve path emits a named absence with scope, evaluation-time asOf, and per-cell basis; an empty rail on a classified parcel is the ADR-029 defect. Fixtures cover all three states and the in-city / unincorporated boundary. Arm 1: Caldwell rural serve names county-absence, not an empty rail. Arm 2: in-city no-table requires unmeasured; a poisoned not-applicable emit is refused. No production job. No store beyond fixtures. No containment figure adopted. Planner commits.
scopeBasis: hauska-factory this registered clone only. Classification is wired against population SHAPE (unincorporated vs in-city; landed table vs none; probed vs unprobed), not against 357269 / 465568 / 826569 or any A1 TOTALS. County easement absences are the T3 four: 48021, 48055, 48209, 48491. Setbacks, edges, and envelope inherit zoning scope. collect_close is the probe receipt; rail_absence is the served row. Live PE brief is not this card (factory-only, build not run).

adversarial.claim: P3 is blocked on A1 containment TOTALS
adversarial.finding: Running a production stamp needs a count. Building the schema, classifier, writer, and serve path needs the three-state rule and the incorporation shape. Waiting for TOTALS puts a full phase back on the serial line. Mechanism: dispatch sentence 'Building it needs the schema, not the number.'
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: hold the card until A1 files 357269; rejected by the dispatch and by the P5/F-11 precedent the card names

adversarial.claim: copy L7 satisfied-absent onto parcel setback rails
adversarial.finding: L7 is SCORE-time counting for sparse statewide-uniform rails (rrc-wells, pipelines, rail-corridor, mud) after a confirmed universe. Parcel setbacks are not a statewide-uniform rail. satisfied-absent on an unincorporated parcel would collapse not-applicable into a looked-and-none vocabulary. The doctrine file itself says it does not authorize that.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: reuse countyLedger displayState mapping; rejected because that mapping is CAD county-cell SCORE, not a parcel rail

adversarial.claim: stamp not-applicable on every parcel without a setback table
adversarial.finding: That is the ruling-forbidden fabrication. In-city with no table is unmeasured. Only unincorporated qualifies for not-applicable. Volume is not evidence of a structural cannot-exist.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: treat the 826569 remainder as structural; rejected by the 2026-08-31 ruling item 2

adversarial.claim: store the absence on county_rail / landing_easement_gis and let PE infer it from a zero atom count
adversarial.finding: That is ADR-029 reproduced: stored absence that never reaches a surface, or a zero count read as unmeasured. W3 item 3 says PE does not read county_manifest for no-footprint-source. The serve path is the point of the phase.
adversarial.rejectedAlternative: one county_rail display_state flip; rejected because the brief still renders an empty rail

collect_close.what: Probe receipt. One row per (rail, scope_kind, scope_id). Fields: evaluated_at (evaluation time, no DEFAULT now()), instrument, finding (structural-unincorporated | no-landed-table | none-found | source-present), source_catalog. Writer cannot insert rail_absence without a matching collect_close id. DDL seeds none.
collect_close.executes: writeCollectClose; requireCollectClose; CHECK collect_close_id IS NOT NULL on rail_absence
collect_close.bypasses: a hand INSERT that forges collect_close_id; schema cannot stop a forged FK to a fake probe, so tests also refuse a close whose evaluated_at is missing

rail_absence_store.what: Served absence row. Parcel scope for setbacks/edges/envelope. County scope for the T3 four easement absences (one row per FIPS, not per parcel). Columns: rail, scope_kind, scope_id, parcel_node_id, county_fips, city_key, incorporation, state, scope_searched, as_of, basis, collect_close_id. CHECK: not-applicable only when incorporation=unincorporated AND rail in (setbacks, edges, envelope). CHECK: unmeasured only when incorporation=in-city. as_of has no DEFAULT now(). No absence seeds in DDL.
rail_absence_store.fails: SQL CHECK on a poisoned in-city not-applicable insert; UNPROBED_ABSENCE without close
rail_absence_store.bypasses: a store that never applies 0006 (this card does not apply)

classifier.what: Pure function. Inputs are independently derived: incorporation (unincorporated|in-city), landedTable boolean, collectClose finding. Zoning-inherited rails (setbacks, edges, envelope): unincorporated -> not-applicable; in-city and no landed table -> unmeasured; in-city and finding none-found -> absent-verified. emitOverride not-applicable on in-city -> IN_CITY_NOT_APPLICABLE. County easement on the T3 four with finding none-found -> absent-verified at county scope. No TOTALS input.
classifier.bypasses: a caller that writes a rail_absence row without calling classify (SQL CHECK is the second door)

writer.what: Copies as_of from collect_close.evaluated_at. Mints basis that includes the cell identity (parcel node, or county+rail+parcel when projecting county coverage). Refuses character-identical basis across two parcel cells. Refuses asOf === requestClock. Dry job only; --apply refuses APPLY_NOT_THIS_CARD / LAPTOP_WRITE_FROZEN. No production.
writer.bypasses: a job that never calls writeRailAbsence

serve.what: serveParcelBrief(store, parcel, {requestClock}) emits every classified rail as a named object {verdict, scope, asOf, basis}. County easement coverage is projected onto the parcel with a per-parcel basis. asOf is the stored evaluation time, never Date.now() and never requestClock. An omitted or null rail is the ADR-029 empty-rail defect and fails the arm-1 fixture.
serve.triggers: unit suite; later PE/brief consumers (not this card)
serve.fails: EMPTY_RAIL; REQUEST_CLOCK_ASOF; IN_CITY_NOT_APPLICABLE on a stuffed row
serve.bypasses: a brief builder that never calls serveParcelBrief (named leave-behind)

fourCountyEasements.what: T3 recon 2026-08-05 four-point probe. County-scope absent-verified for utility-easement on 48021, 48055, 48209, 48491. evaluated_at is the recon probe timestamp 2026-08-05T19:30:00.000Z, not the request clock. 48309 is CAD-derived and is not an absence. City of Bastrop / Round Rock / Cedar Park layers are municipal and do not retire the county row.
fourCountyEasements.triggers: writer fixtures; serve of a Caldwell rural parcel
fourCountyEasements.fails: COUNTY_EASEMENT_NOT_T3 on a fifth FIPS; EMPTY_RAIL if serve does not project the county row
fourCountyEasements.bypasses: a parcel-sentinel fan-out (ADR-029 forbids millions of sentinels)

fixtures.what: Shape, not counts. (1) 48055:RURAL-1 unincorporated -> setbacks/edges/envelope not-applicable AND utility-easement county-absence. (2) 48021:INCITY-NOTABLE in-city no landed table -> unmeasured. (3) 48021:INCITY-PROBED in-city finding none-found -> absent-verified. (4) Boundary pair: same county, one unincorporated and one in-city, different states. (5) Poison: in-city forced not-applicable. (6) Two parcels same basis. (7) asOf equals requestClock. (8) Write without collect_close.

arm1.name: Caldwell rural names county-absence on the wire
arm1.whatWouldProveWrong: serveParcelBrief on fixture 48055:RURAL-1 omits utility-easement, or emits an empty/null rail, or names the county SCORE token satisfied-absent. Stored row that serve does not emit is ADR-029 reproduced.
arm1.passLooksLike: wire.rails['utility-easement'].verdict === 'absent-verified' with scope naming the Caldwell catalog probe, asOf 2026-08-05T19:30:00.000Z, and a basis that includes parcel 48055:RURAL-1. Setbacks on the same parcel are not-applicable, not empty.
arm1.note: Live PE brief is not this card. The serve function is the wire. A later PE consumer that skips it is leave_behind.

arm2.name: in-city no landed table must be unmeasured; poisoned not-applicable must fail
arm2.whatWouldProveWrong: classifyParcelRail or serveParcelRail emits not-applicable for 48021:INCITY-NOTABLE (in-city, no landed table). That is the ruling-forbidden direction.
arm2.passLooksLike: correct path emits unmeasured. Poison path (emitOverride or stuffed row with not-applicable + in-city) throws IN_CITY_NOT_APPLICABLE. CP2 files the poison fail.
arm2.note: This arm is the one that matters. It is stated here before any implementation.
